actions.issue: Escalate North Coast Cold Stores cold-chain delivery failures
actions.driver: Repeated late and incomplete deliveries in affected coastal stores
actions.recommended_action: Agree a two-week recovery plan, reserve daily allocation for the highest-loss chilled SKUs and track every missed delivery.
actions.evidence_status: Observed association; operating cause requires supplier confirmation

actions.issue: Protect KwaZulu-Natal priority stores from repeated stockouts
actions.driver: Loss exposure concentrated in a small set of tracked store-SKU combinations
actions.recommended_action: Introduce twice-weekly exception reviews for the highest-loss stores and move available stock across nearby branches.

actions.driver: Deep winter household and personal-care promotions reduce realised gross margin
actions.recommended_action: Review campaign depth by SKU, require a minimum realised-margin threshold and test narrower offers before renewal.
actions.evidence_status: Observed margin association; incremental demand not experimentally isolated

actions.issue: Rebalance reorder buffers for chilled core lines
actions.driver: Short shelf-life items have little tolerance for delivery slippage
actions.recommended_action: Adjust safety stock on the most material lines after checking expiry exposure and available cold-room capacity.
actions.evidence_status: Recommended control; benefit is an illustrative opportunity

actions.issue: Track supplier service and availability together
actions.driver: Sales-only reporting masks delivery reliability and unmet demand
actions.recommended_action: Publish one weekly exception pack with weighted availability, fill rate, late orders, loss exposure and accountable owners.
actions.evidence_status: Reporting improvement; no standalone savings claimed
